<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1436
Claimant:
Melody Pacheco
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
11/16/2023
First notice of loss received from the claimant, who reports being stopped at a signal when a vehicle struck the rear of
the insured car. The claimant is not represented by counsel and has asked for a copy of the claim file once it is open.
11/25/2023
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was active at the time of the collision. No issues
with the policy terms were found.
12/27/2023
Obtained the police report, which lists the claimant as an occupant of the vehicle at the scene. The responding
officer's notes match the claimant's description of the impact.
03/29/2024
Reviewed the photographs submitted by the claimant. They confirm the location of the damage and the general
position of both vehicles, though they do not show the moment of impact. No independent witnesses have come
forward.
04/11/2024
Inspected the vehicle. The rear bumper, trunk lid, and tail lgiht assembly damage is largely consistent with the
described impact speed and direction. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or repair records.
05/08/2024
Spoke with the claimant about reported neck and back strain. The claimant described the same account of the
collision as in the initial report, with the same sequence of events and details.
05/19/2024
Medical records show the clamiant was treated for the same body area within the last two years. The prior condition
appears to add to the current complaints, so the adjuster is noting it for the medical review.
06/03/2024
Revieewd the injury against the kind and force of the collision. The reported symptoms fit well with the type of impact
described and the damage to the vehicle.
06/25/2024
Treatment followed a typical course of care. Visits and therapy sessions have tapered off as the claimant reports
improvement in range of motion and pain levels.
06/27/2024
Checked for any indication that the damage predates the start of coverage. Nothing in the file suggests that it does,
and the policy effective dates fall well before the loss.
07/01/2024
Reviewed the file summary. Liability appears clear on the basis of the police report and vehicle damage, and the
claim is recommended to proceed to settlement review pending receipt of final treatment records.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
